spec.name: python-dotenv-quoted-roundtrip
spec.rationale: python-dotenv v1.2.4 README File format documents quoted values, escaped backslashes and quotes, and multiline values; tests/test_main.py::test_set_key_round_trips asserts writing and reading restores strings and preserves a following sentinel. src/dotenv/main.py documents interpolate=False to disable POSIX expansion. This extends that existing contract to combinations of the stated characters, using the real public set_key and dotenv_values APIs.
spec.domain: Strings of length 0..120 drawn from the explicit alphabet: ASCII letters/digits, common path and dotenv punctuation including single/double quotes, backslash, dollar/braces, LF, TAB, space, and é/中/🙂. Fixed valid keys VALUE/SENTINEL; UTF-8; quote_mode=always; interpolate=False. Excludes CR (text-mode line-ending normalization), NUL, lone surrogates, arbitrary keys, shell sourcing, interpolation semantics, and filesystem permission/symlink behavior. Files are synthetic and automatically removed.

commands_from_repository_root: cd case-studies/dotenv && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_property_exported.py test_direct_examples.py

pytest.note: pytest test count is not the Hypothesis evaluation count

limitations: No counterexample is not a proof of correctness or a claim that the project has no bugs.
The study targets quoted string values on the stated alphabet, fixed valid keys, UTF-8, and disabled interpolation.
CR, NUL, lone surrogates, arbitrary keys, shell sourcing, other quote modes, permissions and symlinks are outside this study.
The latest stable release was checked. With no counterexample to follow up, current main was not separately executed.
